review_notes: Selected the two actual-data baseline tests explicitly described as the paper’s key predictions: Table 7 Panel A (earnings-return concavity by earnings-volatility quintile) and Table 8 Panel A (earnings-return concavity by investment quintile). Each table supplies five quintile-specific fits of the same Basu-style equation.

Table 6 reports analogous model-simulation patterns, not the actual-data baseline tests. Table 7/8 Panels B and C report secondary cash-flow/accrual outcomes; the abstract and design section identify the two earnings-return tests as the key predictions, so those extra outcomes are outside this baseline family.

The supplied article solves the structural investment model by value-function iteration and calibrates its simulation parameters (physical pp. 14–15, 41). A footnote on physical p. 26 says an SMM parameter fit appears in Online Appendix Section A, but that appendix is absent from the assigned 47-page PDF and reading JSON; no structural estimation equations or fit results were available to extract.

The selected tables describe regressions but do not identify the underlying estimator or print a full equation/intercept convention. The outlier rule is described as deleting tails in the design text (p. 27) and as truncating continuous variables in the selected table notes (pp. 46–47); the implementation distinction is not resolved by the paper.
descriptive_reason: The supplied article provides no data-value descriptive-statistics table or reported means, standard deviations, percentiles, or similar summaries for retained model variables. I checked the model/data correspondence (Table 2), the selected-result discussion, and the selected table pages/notes (physical pp. 26–28 and 42–47); coefficient SEs, fit statistics, quintile definitions, and simulation parameters are not variable descriptives.
results_review_notes: The SMM structural parameter fit is mentioned only in a footnote directing readers to absent Online Appendix Section A; it is not represented by observed predictors or a reconstructed regression in this enrichment.
The assigned PDF and reading JSON contain no sample extraction record; sample_id remains null in both baseline specifications.
